{{Quote|Locked within its recesses, accessible only to a Dark Lord of the Sith, are the forgotten histories and lore, dating back a hundred thousand years and more.|Odan-Urr, to Nomi Sunrider|<ref name="TOTJ:TSW1" />}}
The '''Dark Holocron''', also known as the '''Sith Holocron''', was the name given to a [[Sith holocron/Legends|Sith holocron]] recovered by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Odan-Urr/Legends|Odan-Urr]] from one of the [[Derriphan-class battleship|starships]] in [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow's]] fleet following his defeat at the [[Battle of Koros Major (Great Hyperspace War)|Battle of Koros Major]] some [[5000 BBY/Legends|5,000]] years before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="TOTJ:FOTSE5" /> It was the first known [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] to come into the possession of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="TEGTTF">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>

Though the [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] was recovered before Sadow's retreat to [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], the holocron's [[Gatekeeper/Legends|gatekeeper]] spoke to Odan-Urr of Sadow's escape from Empress [[Teta/Legends|Teta's]] forces and his survival. The holocron remained in the hands of Odan-Urr until his death at the hands of [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]], though, at some point, [[Vodo-Siosk Baas]] was known to have studied the holocron.<ref name="TEGTTF" />

At an unknown time it was recovered by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and came to be stored in the [[Holocron Vault/Legends|Holocron Vaults]] in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Several decades before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the holocron was stolen by [[Lorian Nod]], who was overly curious about the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. Although returned to its place in the temple,<ref name="LotJ" /> [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] obtained it at a later time,<ref name="weapons" /> after which it was lost during the Clone Wars.<ref name="CSWE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Dark Holocron first appeared in the [[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 4|fourth issue]] of [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith|''Dark Lords of the Sith'']] story arc of the [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi (comic series)|''Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi'']] series of comic books, written by [[Tom Veitch]] and [[Kevin J. Anderson]], penciled by [[Chris Gossett]],<ref name="TOTJ:DLOTS4" /> and published on [[January 10]], [[1995]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54574/star_wars_tales_of_the_jedi_-_dark_lords_of_the_sith_1994_4|text=Star Wars: Tales Of The Jedi - Dark Lords Of The Sith (1994) #4}}</ref>

In [[Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War 2|''Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War'' 2]], Exar Kun destroys the Dark Holocron,<ref name="TSW2">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War 2|''Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War'' 2]]</ref> but ''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]'' [[Retroactive continuity|retconned]] the Sith holocron in ''[[Legacy of the Jedi]]'' to be the Dark Holocron.<ref name="weapons" />

When inverted, the [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] inscription in the image above reads, "''In umbris potestas est'',"<ref name="AOTC:TVD" /> which is Latin for, "''In the shadows, there is power.''"
